name: io.github.martusha89/discord-claude-full-mcp
title: Discord (Full)
description: Discord MCP server: messages, images, files, stickers, emoji reactions, and TTS voice notes.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Discord bot token from the Discord Developer Portal

environmentVariables.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ElevenLabs API key. Only needed for the send_voice_note tool

environmentVariables.name: ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID
environmentVariables.description: ElevenLabs voice id used for voice notes. Required alongside the API key

environmentVariables.name: ELEVENLABS_MODEL_ID
environmentVariables.description: ElevenLabs model id. Defaults to eleven_turbo_v2_5

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_DEFAULT_GUILD_ID
environmentVariables.description: Server assumed when a tool call omits the server argument

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_PRIVACY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Message privacy mode: redacted (default), metadata, or full

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_PRIVACY_ALIAS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional secret that keeps privacy aliases stable across Discord token rotation

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_INCLUDE_IMAGES
environmentVariables.description: Include Discord image pixels in read_messages; defaults to true

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MAX_IMAGE_CONTEXT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Combined technical image byte ceiling per read_messages call

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum decoded pixels per image during safe validation

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_IMAGE_READ_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Overall image processing deadline per read_messages call

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_ALLOWED_FILE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated local directories permitted for file attachments

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Configurable technical ceiling for local and remote attachment bytes
